DeMarcus Ware | DeMarcus Omar Ware (born July 31, 1982) is a former American football outside linebacker and defensive end.  He played college football at Troy and was drafted by the Dallas Cowboys with the 11th overall pick in the first round of the 2005 NFL Draft.  After spending nine seasons with the Cowboys, Ware departed in 2013 as the franchise's all-time leader in quarterback sacks with 117. In 2017, he signed a one-day contract with Dallas to retire as a Cowboy.
